item.title: SpaceXAI Releases Grokipedia v0.3 Update with New Design Tweaks
item.description:
SpaceXAI Releases Grokipedia v0.3 Update with New Design Tweaks

SpaceXAI has released a v0.3 update for Grokipedia, its AI-powered competitor to Wikipedia. The update introduces a new logo and visual refreshes to the homepage, article pages, and live edits page, following a period where the site recently resumed incorporating edits.

⚙️ Key details

Benji Taylor, head of design at SpaceXAI, describes the update as a “newly refreshed Grokipedia.” The v0.3 release follows a development timeline that began with v0.1 in late October 2025, which used AI-cloned pages from Wikipedia, and a v0.2 update a month later. While a Lawfare report in August stated that no entry had changed in more than three months, the site has recently started updating again.

🎨 Visual and Functional Changes

  • Homepage: Previously consisting of a logo and search bar, the new homepage now includes:
    • A list of featured articles featuring digital representations of books that can be spun around.
    • A most-read articles section utilizing a horizontally-scrolling shelf of “book” spines.
    • A tracker for “latest edits.”
  • Live Edits Page: Updated to allow users to see more recent changes at once.
  • Article Pages: Now feature smaller spacing between lines of text and a redesigned format for the key facts tables located at the top of articles.

#SpaceXAI #Grokipedia #AI #Wikipedia

Source: Elon Musk’s Grokipedia has a ‘newly refreshed’ design

item.title: Grokipedia Resumes Article Updates After Months-Long Pause
item.description:
Grokipedia Resumes Article Updates After Months-Long Pause

Grokipedia, the AI‑powered online encyclopedia from SpaceXAI, has started updating articles again after a months‑long pause.

🔍 Overview

  • Grokipedia is an AI‑powered online encyclopedia built by SpaceXAI.
  • After a months‑long pause, the platform is showing new activity.

⚙️ Recent Activity

  • The live‑updates site now displays recent changes, many labeled “recheck all references and sources.”
  • The Barack Obama page shows a note that it was “Fact‑checked by Grok” two days ago.
  • The Elon Musk page was fact‑checked within the last hour.
  • The Honolulu page was last fact‑checked 7 months ago, indicating uneven coverage.

🛠️ User Contributions

  • A suggested edit to the Gears of War: E‑Day page adding the October 6 release date was accepted and now appears on the article.
  • A request for a new article about Meta’s Muse chatbot is listed as “In Review.”

📢 Statements from Leadership

  • About a year ago, Elon Musk claimed Grokipedia would be “a massive improvement over Wikipedia.”
  • Benji Taylor, head of design at X and SpaceXAI, posted last week: “We haven’t forgotten about Grokipedia” and “v0.2 will be better than ever” (v0.2 launched in November).

🚧 Current Limitations

  • SpaceXAI did not respond to a request for comment.
  • Elon Musk has not posted about Grokipedia on X since February.
